authorized_activities: Offline access to the sealed evaluation transcript key exclusively for the registered scoring procedure.
Verify all 16,500 evaluation transcript records and their correspondence with the frozen online inference manifest.
Score all 16,500 evaluation clips across Arm 1 (Static), Arm 2 (Ungated SUTA), and Arm 3 (DSG-gated SUTA).
Calculate registered pooled speaker-level WER across all 1,100 evaluation speakers.
Calculate five-stratum accent-disparity outcomes (D_arm = max WER - min WER, Delta D = D_3 - D_1).
Perform registered stratified-cluster bootstrap for Event D (B=20,000 resamples, seed=42).
Perform single-step simultaneous Bonferroni multiplicity correction (M=8, alpha_adj=0.00625, 99.375% percentile UCB).
Produce comprehensive machine-readable (.json) and human-readable (.md) research reports.
mandatory_restrictions: Do not modify frozen Gate 5 predictions (results/stage6m_cohort3_results/prequential_stream_records.jsonl, SHA-256: 42fc02ce...).
Do not retrain or adapt any model.
Do not expose evaluation transcripts to Kaggle or external network services.
Do not include reserve labels or reserve recordings (975 clips) in the primary evaluation.
Do not alter registered hypotheses or thresholds (Event A < 0.00 pp, Event B < 0.00 pp, Event C <= +2.00 pp, Event D <= 0.00 pp).
Preserve all input hashes, scoring logs, and outputs.
stop_conditions: Stop on any missing or duplicate recording ID.
Stop on any hash mismatch against frozen catalogue.
Stop on any incorrect transcript mapping.
Stop on any deviation from the approved statistical protocol.
